research_scope: Time Skip/Jump Spike — Strike Super / Counter Skill.

verification_audit.classification_finding: Xenoverse 2 reference classifies Jump Spike as a Strike Super and Counter Skill. Canonical identity is Super / Strike.
verification_audit.acquisition_finding: Training with Hit, School Quest Lesson 2; Dragon Ball Wiki says Future Warrior can learn it through Hit's Training.
verification_audit.availability_finding: Future Warrior acquisition is documented; usable_by_cac true.
verification_audit.finish_policy: Instructor training rather than PQ reward; ultimate_finish_required false.
verification_audit.mechanics_finding: User flies forward and strikes the opponent, with approximately 20% damage. During the rush the user is impermeable to Strike attacks; holding the input increases flight range.

records.name: Time Skip/Jump Spike
records.source_quest_or_shop: School Quest — Lesson 2 of Hit's Training
records.ultimate_finish_evidence: Documented acquisition is instructor training, not a Parallel Quest reward.
records.skill_description: Fly and then time skip before attacking an opponent. Holding longer increases flight distance.
records.mechanics_notes: The user flies forward and strikes for approximately 20% damage. The user is protected from Strike attacks during the rush; holding the input extends flight range.
records.acquisition_notes: Dragon Ball Wiki documents the Future Warrior learning the skill in Hit's Lesson 2. It also documents a historical Lesson 2 plot-description naming error that was later fixed.
records.pvp_notes: Current frame data and matchup-specific details are not independently verified.
